name: Table Type Validation E2E
description: Design-time table validation functional fixture: a single table variable (results) carried as row-objects with an integer id column and a string name column, plus a Log anchor so the test validates with zero errors. The spec opens the inspect modal in edit and drives the shared table-schema validator across the Visual and Code views - invalid cells, duplicate / unexpected / missing columns, the multi-problem (+N more) list, the invalid-JSON and structure Visual-switch locks, and the Compare mode pill color.
